installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# FiveM Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apt update -y
apt install -y tar xz-utils curl git file jq unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

RELEASE_PAGE=$(curl -sSL https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/)
CHANGELOGS_PAGE=$(curl -sSL https://changelogs-live.fivem.net/api/changelog/versions/linux/server)

# Check whether to run installation or update version of script
if [ ! -d "./alpine/" ] && [ ! -d "./resources/" ]; then
  # Install script
  echo "Beginning installation of new FiveM server."

  if [[ "${FIVEM_VERSION}" == "recommended" ]] || [[ -z ${FIVEM_VERSION} ]]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo $CHANGELOGS_PAGE | jq -r '.recommended_download')
  elif [[ "${FIVEM_VERSION}" == "latest" ]]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo $CHANGELOGS_PAGE | jq -r '.latest_download')
  else
    VERSION_LINK=$(echo -e "${RELEASE_PAGE}" | grep -Eo '".*/*.tar.xz"' | grep -Eo '".*/*.tar.xz"' | sed 's/\\\"/\\\//g'  | sed 's/\\.\\\\/\\\//1' | grep -i "${FIVEM_VERSION}" | grep -o =.* |  tr -d '=')
    if [[ "${VERSION_LINK}" == "" ]]; then
      echo -e "Defaulting to recommended as the version requested was invalid."
      DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo $CHANGELOGS_PAGE | jq -r '.recommended_download')
    else
      DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/${VERSION_LINK})
    fi
  fi

  # Download artifact and get filetype
  echo -e "Running curl -sSL ${DOWNLOAD_LINK} -o ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}..."
  curl -sSL ${DOWNLOAD_LINK} -o ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
  
  # Unpack artifact depending on filetype
  echo "Extracting FiveM FXServer artifact files..."
  FILETYPE=$(file -F ',' ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/} | cut -d',' -f2 | cut -d' ' -f2)
  if [ "$FILETYPE" == "gzip" ]; then
    tar xzvf ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
  elif [ "$FILETYPE" == "Zip" ]; then
    unzip ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
  elif [ "$FILETYPE" == "XZ" ]; then
    tar xvf ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
  else
    echo -e "Downloaded artifact of unknown filetype. Exiting."
    exit 2
  fi

  # Delete original bash launch script
  rm -rf ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/} run.sh

  if [ -e server.cfg ]; then
    echo "Server config file already exists. Skipping download of new one."
  else
    echo "Downloading default FiveM server config..."
    curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodebytehosting/recipes/develop/games/rockstar/fivem/server.cfg >> server.cfg
  fi

  # Clone resources repo from git or install FiveM default resources
  if [ "${GIT_ENABLED}" == "1" ] && [ ! -d "/mnt/server/resources" ]; then
    # Download from git
    echo "Preparing to clone resources repo from git.";

    if [[ ${GIT_REPOURL} != *.git ]]; then # Add .git at end of URL
      GIT_REPOURL=${GIT_REPOURL}.git
    fi

    if [ -z "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${GIT_TOKEN}" ]; then # Check for git username & token
      echo -e "Git Username or Git Token was not specified."
    else
      GIT_REPOURL="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_REPOURL} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
    fi

    if [ -z ${GIT_BRANCH} ]; then
      echo -e "Cloning default branch into /resources/*."
      git clone ${GIT_REPOURL} /mnt/server/resources
    else
      echo -e "Cloning ${GIT_BRANCH} branch into /resources/*."
      git clone --single-branch --branch ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_REPOURL} /mnt/server/resources && echo "Finished cloning into /resources/* from Git." || echo "Failed cloning into /resources/* from Git."
    fi

  else
    # Download FiveM default server resources
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/resources
    echo "Preparing to clone default FiveM resources."
    git clone https://github.com/citizenfx/cfx-server-data.git /tmp && echo "Downloaded server from git." || echo "Downloading from git failed."
    cp -Rf /tmp/resources/* resources/
  fi

  mkdir -p logs/
  echo "Installation complete."

else
  # Update script
  echo "Beginning update of existing FiveM FXServer server artifact."

  # Delete old artifact
  if [ -d "./alpine/" ]; then
    echo "Deleting old FXServer artifact..."
    rm -r ./alpine/
    while [ -d "./alpine/" ]; do
      sleep 1s
    done
    echo "Deleted old FXServer artifact files successfully."
  fi

  if [[ "${FIVEM_VERSION}" == "recommended" ]] || [[ -z ${FIVEM_VERSION} ]]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo $CHANGELOGS_PAGE | jq -r '.recommended_download')
  elif [[ "${FIVEM_VERSION}" == "latest" ]]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo $CHANGELOGS_PAGE | jq -r '.latest_download')
  else
    VERSION_LINK=$(echo -e "${RELEASE_PAGE}" | grep -Eo '".*/*.tar.xz"' | grep -Eo '".*/*.tar.xz"' | sed 's/\\\"/\\\//g'  | sed 's/\\.\\\\/\\\//1' | grep -i "${FIVEM_VERSION}" | grep -o =.* |  tr -d '=')
    if [[ "${VERSION_LINK}" == "" ]]; then
      echo -e "Defaulting to recommended as the version requested was invalid."
      DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo $CHANGELOGS_PAGE | jq -r '.recommended_download')
    else
      DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/${VERSION_LINK})
    fi
  fi

  # Download artifact and get filetype
  echo -e "Running curl -sSL ${DOWNLOAD_LINK} -o ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}..."
  curl -sSL ${DOWNLOAD_LINK} -o ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}

  # Unpack artifact depending on filetype
  echo "Extracting FiveM FXServer artifact files..."
  FILETYPE=$(file -F ',' ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/} | cut -d',' -f2 | cut -d' ' -f2)
  if [ "$FILETYPE" == "gzip" ]; then
    tar xzvf ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
  elif [ "$FILETYPE" == "Zip" ]; then
    unzip ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
  elif [ "$FILETYPE" == "XZ" ]; then
    tar xvf ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
  else
    echo -e "Downloaded artifact of unknown filetype. Exiting."
    exit 2
  fi

  # Delete original bash launch script
  rm -rf ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/} run.sh

  echo "Update complete."

fi

variables.name: CFX License Key
variables.description: Required to start the service. Get your keys at https://portal.cfx.re/

variables.name: Steam Web Api Key
variables.description: Use your Steam WebApiKey or set to 'none'. Get your key at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey/.

variables.name: FXServer Version
variables.description:
Downloads the latest or specified FiveM FXServer artifact.

Can be set to 'latest', 'recommended', or a specific version.

You can find the latest version from here - https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/

Pressing 'Reinstall Server' in 'Settings' will remove the currently installed FXServer artifact and replace it with an updated one.

variables.name: Git Enabled
variables.description: Enabling this will clone or pull the specified repository into /resources on each server startup. If you are installing the server now, this will clone the git repo.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: The username used to authenticate with git.

variables.name: Git Token
variables.description:
The password used to authenticate with git.

It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
https://github.com/settings/tokens
https://gitlab.com/-/profile/personal_access_tokens

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description:
URL to Git repository.

Example: https://github.com/citizenfx/cfx-server-data

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: The name of the branch you wish to use. The default will be used if this is not specified.

variables.name: Enable txAdmin
variables.description:
Enables txAdmin.

(default is off)

variables.name: txAdmin Port
variables.description: The port for the txAdmin panel.

variables.name: FiveM Game Build
variables.description:
Sets the sv_enforceGameBuild convar. This specifies the client GTA build the server should be on.
Read docs for possible values: https://docs.fivem.net/docs/server-manual/server-commands/#sv_enforcegamebuild-build

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Sets the maximum player count.

variables.name: Server Hostname
variables.description: The name that shows up when selecting the server in the server browser.

variables.name: Project Name
variables.description: The name that shows up in the server browser.

variables.name: Project Description
variables.description: The description that shows up in the server browser.
variables.default_value: Default project description. Please change me.

variables.name: Onesync
variables.description: Set to 'on' to enable Onesync. Set to 'off' if you want to disable Onesync. Optionally you can use 'legacy' however it is strongly advised against. If you are running a server you should have Onesync enabled.

variables.name: Use3dAudio
variables.description: Enable or disable 3d audio. Does nothing if 'UseNativeAudio' is set to true.

variables.name: UseSendingRangeOnly
variables.description: Use sending range only.

variables.name: UseNativeAudio
variables.description: Enable or disable Native audio. You should be using this for the best possible VOIP. Greatly superior to 'Use3dAudio'.

variables.name: txAdmin Data Path
variables.description: The location txAdmin stores data.

variables.name: txAdmin Game Name
variables.description:
Restricts to only running either FiveM or RedM servers.
The setup page will only show recipes for the game specified below!
Options are: fivem or redm

variables.name: FXServer Port
variables.description:
The game server port (TCP + UDP). This must match your Pterodactyl server allocation port.

This sets TXHOST_FXS_PORT for txAdmin.
